description.value: Good Life Juice is a Vancouver Island-based cold-pressed juice and health food shop offering unpasteurized juices, nut milks, smoothies, cleanses, salads, bowls, and soups made from fresh produce. The shop operates a walk-in fridge stocked seven days a week with no pre-order required, making it an easy stop for a nutrient-packed pick-me-up. They also supply commercial clients across Vancouver Island including hotels, restaurants, and local distilleries.
